# Forceget Supply Chain Logistics - Powered by AI

Forceget Supply Chain Logistics - Powered by AI is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Forceget is a global supply chain partner offering ocean & air freight forwarding, customs brokerage, warehousing, and e-commerce fulfillment including Amazon FBA/FBM. Forceget Supply Chain Logistics - Powered by AI employs 60 people (+9.1% YoY, +5 people), founded in 2020. Headquartered in Miami Beach, Florida, United States, with offices in Perris, Philadelphia, and Miami. Its workforce is distributed across 6 countries (including Colombia, Turkey, United States, Philippines, and China).

## About

Forceget is an omnichannel fulfillment company for e-commerce brands selling on Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop, Walmart, and retail.
 
Most brands run freight, warehousing, and fulfillment through 3 or 4 vendors. Every handoff adds cost, delay, and another inventory count that does not match. Forceget runs the full chain under same platform from the factory to the customer's door.
 
Freight
Ocean (FCL, LCL, DDP), air, truckload, LTL, and drayage. Customs clearance, HTS classification, and cargo insurance. Instant freight quotes online.
 
Fulfillment
Amazon FBA prep, FBM, Seller Fulfilled Prime, AWD, DTC, B2B, and retail/EDI orders. Bicoastal warehouses in Perris, CA and Philadelphia, PA put inventory within 2 days of more US customers.
 
Software
The Forceget Platform: WMS, real-time inventory sync across 21+ marketplace integrations, automated FBA replenishment, shipment tracking, and API access.
 
The receipts
Founded in 2020. 4th year exhibiting at Amazon Accelerate. We guarantee at least 15% lower fulfillment costs with faster delivery.
 
As a US multichannel 3PL, we work with operators adding their 2nd, 3rd, or 4th channel, the point where most brands break about fulfillment.
 
Book a free fulfillment audit. We run the math on your own orders: forceget.com

# CGETC

CGETC is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. CGETC Inc is a company that provides end-to-end infrastructure for global beauty brands scaling in the US. CGETC employs 27 people (+17.4% YoY, +4 people), founded in 2003. Headquartered in City of Industry, California, United States, with an office in Lawrenceville. Its workforce is distributed across United States and South Korea.

## About

CGETC helps global beauty and wellness brands win in the U.S. — not just survive, but thrive.

Founded in 2003, we run the operational layer most brands can't see and shouldn't have to: international freight, customs, warehousing, omnichannel fulfillment, B2B distribution, DTC operations, and U.S. market-entry support. Our proprietary Atlas system gives brands real-time visibility into inventory, shipping, and cost across every channel.

We're building towards a one-stop cross-border infrastructure platform for beauty — pairing logistics with forecasting, trend analysis, and data intelligence. Our goal is to provide a seamless, reliable path from Asia to the U.S., and be the operational backbone for brands to scale with confidence. 

Learn more at cgetc.com.
